subject: Discovery recap + economic buyer / budget owner intro - Redwood trial for recommendations
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <a.chen@zenithtech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Redwood trial for recommendations)

Hi Alex - thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned:

Summary of needs:
- Use case: in-app personalized recommendations for high-value product pages (real-time ranking + contextual prompts)
- Target throughput: ~250 QPS peak with 50-100ms p95 latency target for top-tier pages
- Data residency: US-only for PII; sanitized product/context sent to model for inference
- Evaluation criteria: latency, per-token cost, and accuracy uplift vs. current baseline

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm economic buyer / budget owner so I can send a short proposal and pricing range (we don't need an exact number yet).
2) Security & procurement contacts (for SOC2 docs and typical vendor questionnaire).
3) 30-min follow-up with engineering + procurement to cover deployment options (hosted vs dedicated) and contracting timeline.

I've attached a short one-pager and a draft RFP Q&A that map to what we discussed.

If you can intro me to the budget owner and procurement contact, I'll follow up with a tailored one-pager and proposed mutual action plan.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- zenith_mappit_pipeline.pdf (one-pager)
- zenith_rfp_questions.docx (RFP draft)

Thanks Marissa - great recap and helpful docs. I've looped in the folks who own budget and security: Priya Reddy (Head of Procurement / budget owner) and Sara Landry (Security PM). Priya will own contracting and Sara will handle the vendor questionnaire.

Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@zenithtech.com>
Sara Landry <sara.landry@zenithsec.com>

Redwood's runtime and batching strategy look promising for our cost targets; they also have a dedicated option which might be relevant for our higher-volume pages. Could you confirm who on procurement should own the PO/contract conversation and whether we need an NDA / legal intake before vendor demos?

I'm open to a 30-min follow-up next week - Tue/Wed morning PT works for me.

Subject: Intro + short ask: budget owner / contracting discussion (Redwood)

Hi Priya - nice to e-meet you, and thanks Alex for the intro. I'm Marissa (Enterprise AE at Redwood Inference). Quick context: we had a discovery with Alex today on using Redwood for in-app recommendations. We think we can meet your latency and cost targets, but to move toward a trial and commercial terms I'd love to confirm the procurement process and the correct budget owner.

Short asks:
- Can you confirm who owns the budget for recommendation/ML infra projects?
- Preferred procurement process (PO vs. contract + SOW)?
- Any required legal intake (NDA, security forms) before a pilot?

If it's helpful I can send a short 1-page pricing range and a 30-min slot to cover contracting. Proposed slots: Tue 3/16 10:30-11:00 PT or Wed 3/17 09:00-09:30 PT.

We'll also make sure Rishi (solutions engineer) is on the follow-up to cover architecture and any compliance questions.

Thanks - happy to be flexible on timing.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com

Marissa - thanks for the reach out and the materials. I own the procurement envelope for platform/ML infra spend and can own the commercial conversation. A few notes up front:

- We typically do a 1-2 month pilot under an MSA + SOW, then convert to a PO for committed capacity.
- We require SOC2 report + standard security questionnaire answered before pilot kickoff. Sara (cc'd) will own the security review.
- For pricing we expect a rough range up front; you can share a pricing band and a short mutual action plan.

I can do Wed 3/17 09:00-09:30 PT for a 30-min sync. Please include a short pricing range + any playbook for hosted vs dedicated options in your prep.

Priya Reddy
Head of Procurement | Zenith Technologies
